# Signatory Ghost Ship — Clean-Room Canonical Draft — Battle Map Authority

CANONICAL RULE: Foundry scene geometry is authoritative. Artwork is only a rendering of this geometry.
Never move canonical walls, doors, lights, floor topology, scene dimensions, scale, or background transform to rescue a drifting art pass. Reject or regenerate the artwork instead.

## Concept
Abandoned Accords derelict reliquary vessel adrift in interstellar space. Infantry-scale exploration through narrow oppressive corridors linking navigation, communications, weapons access, reliquary spaces, and engineering. Sporadic emergency illumination; no living crew.

## Coordinate spaces
- Hex space: odd-row horizontal hex coordinates used for gameplay topology.
- Scene space: 1230 × 589 px, derived from 20 × 11 hexes at 60px grid size.
- Artwork space: MUST be exactly 1230 × 589 px with no scaling, translation, padding, or rotation.

## Gameplay geometry
- Scale: personnel; 1 hex = 1.5 m.
- Grid: hex_rows_odd; Foundry overlay authoritative; do not paint a permanent grid into final player artwork.
- Walkable hexes: 65.
- Legal transitions: 90.
- Solid walls: 60.
- Doors: 9.
- Lights: 20.
- Regions: C-AUX-ACCESS, C-COMMS-ACCESS, C-CRYPT-ACCESS, C-ENGINEERING-ACCESS, C-NAV-ACCESS, C-RELIQUARY-ACCESS, C-SPINE, C-WEAPONS-ACCESS, R-AUX, R-COMMS, R-CRYPT, R-ENGINEERING, R-NAV, R-RELIQUARY, R-WEAPONS.

## Hard spatial rules for the art pass
Preserve the exact architectural footprint supplied by the deterministic reference.
Preserve every wall position, doorway, corridor width, room footprint, machinery exclusion zone, and light-fixture origin.
Do not add or remove passages. Do not shift architectural boundaries. Do not create decorative architecture that occludes a legal hex-to-hex movement path.
All navigable floor regions and intended transitions are authoritative. Straight architectural bulkheads may cross the visual hex grid at arbitrary angles only where the canonical skeleton places them.
The final artwork must use the exact Scene-space dimensions and identity background registration.

## Aesthetic direction
Premium hand-painted top-down sci-fi battle map with disciplined 1990s Japanese mechanical-anime clarity; high information, low noise; functional spacecraft architecture.
Ancient Accords reliquary vessel: dark-fey raider visual language, ivory structural armor, dark iron interiors, aged bronze fittings, restrained crimson heraldry, ritual reliquary motifs. Abandoned but structurally intact; sporadic pools of emergency illumination and dead corridors.
- REQUIRED: Navigation, communications, weapons access, reliquary spaces, and engineering remain legible as functional compartments.
- REQUIRED: Straight believable bulkheads enclose the authored hex topology without becoming honeycomb architecture.
- REQUIRED: Every authored light origin appears as a plausible physical fixture.
- PROHIBITED: Do not move, add, or remove walls or door openings.
- PROHIBITED: Do not change corridor widths or room footprints.
- PROHIBITED: Do not place decorative architecture across legal movement paths.
- PROHIBITED: Do not add crew, creatures, tokens, labels, or a baked-in hex grid to final player artwork.
- PROHIBITED: Do not turn straight bulkheads into hex-shaped walls merely because movement uses a hex grid.
